answer:
| Feature | Mechanism | Machine |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Definition** | An assembly of rigid or resistant bodies configured to transmit motion. | A mechanism or a combination of mechanisms that transmits force to do useful mechanical work. |
| **Energy Transformation** | Does not necessarily transmit significant power or transform energy types. | Specifically designed to receive energy and transform it into useful mechanical work. |
proTip: Every machine is a mechanism, but not every mechanism is a machine.
